mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% for two consecutive months signals weak consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown, increasing input costs and reducing corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals inflationary pressure prompting monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%) supports consumer demand and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth exceeding 100,000 (PAYEMS > 100,000) indicates robust labor market conditions boosting consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive months of industrial production below 95.0 signal manufacturing weakness, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.
